lines: [voice breaking] I held you for three days.
[cold, controlled] If you bring her into this house, you will regret it.
[smooth, defensive] It was a hypothetical question.
[exploding] You have no idea what this family has sacrificed!
[clipped] Mother, the caterers arrive at four.
[soft but steady] That's what everyone in this family says whenever they're hiding something.
[urgent whisper] Grandma, Dad knew about Anna.
[trembling] I've waited forty years to hear someone say that.
[heavy, honest] Because I was young, ambitious, and more concerned with keeping a powerful client than doing the right thing.
